svg.title: Initialization quality and the contribution of later search
svg.text: Initialization quality and the contribution of later search
A Hypervolume over the full logical budget
B Typical throughput: initial to later slots
C Typical p99: initial to later slots
A: thin lines are seeds; thick lines are method means. The fixed hypervolume reference and all 30 slots are retained.
B/C: each segment joins slots 1-12 (left) to 13-30 (right). BO shares its initialization; random/Sobol use their own first 12.
Stage contrasts are descriptive and chronologically confounded. Controls are interpolated; no causal stage effect is claimed.
